scope: Official references checked before the new camera work; reference artwork and extension code are not copied.

references.title: Turnaround Camera
references.observation: Official Blender Extensions listing describes a camera orbit around the selected object. Previously bundled community add-on, limited support, no special permissions.
references.decision: Existing installed dcc-mcp-blender camera, objects and animation skills expose the small rig needed here, so no extension install or extra dependency is necessary.

references.title: Turntable Camera
references.observation: Official extension listing offers editable camera turntable keyframes, root empty and elevation controls.
references.decision: Reuse the same ordinary camera-rig idea through existing typed MCP tools, without installing or copying the add-on.

references.title: Charge production articles
references.observation: The official Studio index includes set design, battery prop design and EEVEE production articles, including 2025 entries.
references.decision: Use purposeful material and silhouette views with visible real geometry. No Studio artwork, assets or textures enter this case.

references.title: Blender Studio Production Session: Charge! vs. Wing It!
references.observation: Official presentation describes both productions using EEVEE.
references.decision: Evaluate EEVEE with an actual frame on the available host before choosing a renderer; an official reference does not establish compatibility on this machine.
